name: Rampapang
source:
Rampapang is a Horror Otome


In need of cash, you decide to find a roommate! You expect normal roommate things: sharing spaces, getting to know each other, and rearranging your home to fit two. You don't sign up for the possibility of getting eaten, but you might get it anyway.

[From [url=https://ahoegang.itch.io/rampapang]itch.io[/url]]
